hints.title: Node name
hints.body: Node names must be unique within a workflow. Use short, descriptive names — they show up in logs and errors.
hints.notes: Author-only: PMs asked for this because 'unique' error was confusing users.

hints.title: Region
hints.body: Choose the region closest to your data. You can't change this after the project is created.

hints.title: Max tokens
hints.body: The maximum number of tokens the model can generate per response. Higher = longer answers but more cost.
